name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds Section Content Order Settings for all section types; supports title, release date, date added, rating, and manual ordering; adds the functional Add Section to Home Screen action; persists applied sections; renders custom rows alongside Jellyfin rows through File Transformation; and keeps Continue Watching at the top. Requires Abyss, Collection Manager, and a Jellyfin 10.11-compatible File Transformation release.
